ABOUT US

50 years of supplement manufacturing expertise behind every brand we partner with.

DaVinci Laboratories has been formulating dietary supplements for integrative physicians and serious brand-builders since 1976. Our private label program brings that decades-deep expertise to entrepreneurs and established brands launching their own supplement lines.

Schedule a Consultation

Built on truth in labeling, scientific rigor, and respect for the entrepreneur.

DaVinci Laboratories of Vermont was founded in 1976 with a simple commitment: build dietary supplements that integrative healthcare professionals could trust to actually work. That commitment shaped everything that came after: how we source ingredients, how we formulate, how we test, and how we label what is in the bottle.

Five decades later, we have grown into a 250-plus product catalog manufactured in our FDA-registered, GMP-certified Vermont facility. The original commitment has not changed. What is on the label is what is in the bottle. No proprietary blends hiding underdosing. No cheap fillers we will not disclose. No marketing claims our science cannot support.

OUR HERITAGE

From integrative medicine to the entrepreneur's brand.

For most of our history, DaVinci's primary customer was the integrative medicine community: naturopathic doctors, functional medicine practitioners, chiropractors, and other healthcare professionals who recommended our supplements to their patients. That clinical scrutiny shaped our formulation standards. Our products had to work, had to be safe, and had to be backed by science that practitioners could defend to their peers.

We launched our private label program to extend that same manufacturing standard to a broader audience: entrepreneurs and established brand-builders who want to launch their own supplement lines without compromising on quality. The same facility, the same formulations, the same testing protocols, just under your brand.

WHAT WE STAND FOR

Three commitments that shape every decision.

Truth in labeling

What is on the label is what is in the bottle. No proprietary blends hiding underdosing. No fillers we will not disclose. Your customers (and their healthcare providers) can trust your products at the ingredient level. We hold ourselves to this standard not because regulations demand it, but because it is the right way to formulate supplements.

Scientific rigor

Every formulation is doctor-formulated and scientifically reviewed before it enters production. We use clinical-grade ingredients at therapeutic doses, not marketing doses. When the research changes, our formulations evolve. This is how supplements actually deliver outcomes customers can feel.

Partnership, not transaction

Our private label clients are not accounts on a spreadsheet. They are brand-builders we work alongside for years. We share what we have learned in 50 years of supplement manufacturing because helping you build a great brand is what makes this work meaningful for our team.

OUR FACILITY

Manufactured in Vermont, where the company has lived since 1976.

Our facility in Williston, Vermont houses production lines for capsules, tablets, powders, softgels, chewables, liquids, and oral sprays. On-site quality laboratory. Climate-controlled raw material warehousing. Finished goods inventory for ready-to-ship private label SKUs. FDA-registered. GMP certified to SQF food safety and NSF GMP 455-2 standards. Run by people who have been making dietary supplements together for decades.

PARENT COMPANY

Part of the FoodScience family.

DaVinci Laboratories of Vermont is part of the FoodScience family of companies, a U.S. owned manufacturer of nutritional supplements for humans and pets. FoodScience operates multiple manufacturing facilities and product brands serving the integrative medicine, retail, veterinary, and private label channels. The scale of FoodScience gives our DaVinci private label clients access to manufacturing infrastructure, ingredient sourcing networks, and quality systems that would be impossible at a smaller scale.

Operating at the DaVinci level keeps the relationship with each private label client direct and personal. You work with our team. The same people who answer your questions during evaluation are the people who manage your engagement after launch.

HOW IT WORKS

Get to market faster with a partner who handles the heavy lifting.

Direct access to over 250 doctor-formulated supplements with low minimums and no set-up fees. Choose what fits your audience and your timeline.

03

START SELLING FAST

Launch in as little as 3 to 4 weeks after approving your labels. Every product passes rigorous quality assurance before it ships.

Ready to put 50 years of supplement manufacturing behind your brand?

Schedule a consultation and we will walk through your business goals, the right path to launch, and what the next 90 days look like working together.

50+ YEARS OF SUPPLEMENT MANUFACTURING

Developed by us. Made for you.

With over 50 years in the health supplement industry, we are one of the most trusted dietary supplement manufacturers. Every private label supplement we produce is doctor-formulated using thoroughly researched ingredients, then scientifically reviewed for efficacy and quality before it ever enters production in our U.S. facilities.

FoodScience is an FDA-registered food facility, GMP certified to SQF food safety standards, and certified to NSF GMP 455-2.

When you partner with us, our expert team is with you every step of the way. Help your customers find what they want from a source they trust. You.
